selection_policy: grid fixed in source; rank by 2019 correct winners, then seat error, then share MAE; 2024 labels never select strengths

methods.regradient: baseline-aligned party slope correction learned from prior elections; national target preserved by raking
methods.place_residual: rolling prior-election residual by region plus shrunk region/winner/runner-up/margin-band competition cell; no constituency identity
methods.spatial_scope: low-dimensional place proxy, not a full ICAR adjacency model

benchmark_2024_pre2024_shortlist.warning: All candidates in this shortlist were selected/ranked on 2019 before 2024 was inspected; the 2024 comparison is diagnostic only.
